# Repository instructions

Follow the root `AGENTS.md` for product boundaries, credential handling,
validation commands and pull-request review etiquette.

In particular, review fixes must be pushed before posting an explanatory reply
inside each original inline thread and resolving it. Never silently resolve a
conversation or substitute a top-level comment. When a review/fix loop has been
requested, request re-review of the updated head and do not merge without
explicit authorization.
